title: CDP Neighbor Discovery and Topology Audit
summary: Discover network topology, verify physical interconnects, and audit device capabilities using Cisco Discovery Protocol (CDP) commands, followed by security hardening on edge interfaces.
learning_objectives: Explain the protocol mechanics, TLV structure, and operational role of Cisco Discovery Protocol (CDP) at Layer 2
Map unknown multi-device network topologies without physical access using 'show cdp neighbors' and 'show cdp neighbors detail'
Audit neighbor device platforms, hardware capabilities, management IP addresses, and remote port identifiers
Inspect local and remote interface CDP operational timers and holdtime values using 'show cdp interface'
Harden access-layer switchports facing untrusted endpoints by selectively disabling CDP with 'no cdp enable'
Evaluate the operational and security implications of disabling CDP globally using 'no cdp run'

source.origin: Independently authored network fundamentals curriculum guide based on IEEE 802.3 LLC and Cisco Discovery Protocol specifications
